verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform that runs its own AI agents (Fieldwork), so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows the opposite role: Oneleet publishes its own MCP server for external assistants to connect to. Nothing shows Oneleet itself registering or calling third-party MCP servers' tools. Server-side evidence comes from a different story and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
